text:
maria: Deployed release v2.8.1 to canary (canary pool A) at 16:05 UTC. Kicking off quick smoke-suite. @deploy-bot run: smoke-suite --mode canary-small

deploy-bot: ✅ started smoke-suite (canary-small). probes: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth. expected runtime ~2m. posting live results to thread.

devin: Quick decision rules: hold/rollback if any p95 > 250ms OR 5xx rate > 0.5% on canary. If it's regional, pin that region and continue elsewhere.

sre-oncall: seeing an early blip on embed-synth in eu1: p95 ~310ms and 5xx ~1.1% in the trace tail. throwing an alert to #incidents.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite results (canary-small):
- kv-prefill: OK (latency p95 42ms)
- http-heartbeat: OK (no 5xx)
- embed-synth: FAIL — p95=312ms, 5xx=1.2% (threshold exceeded)
Marking canary status: FAIL.

maria: Ugh. Do we rollback the canary or pin model variant? Any quick root cause guesses?

jess: can we see if it's a model variant swap? I noticed the canary used model: redwood-open/mtl-13b-quant-v2. new quant profile maybe?

devin: timeline: last model variant change was the quant switch in the deploy. My vote: rollback canary to the previous stable (v2.7.4) and pin until we validate patch. I'll issue rollback command.

# command
```
/deploy rollback inference canary --to-version v2.7.4 --reason "embed-synth p95 spike on eu1"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by devin at 16:07 UTC. Rolling back canary pool A -> v2.7.4. Estimated completion ~45s. Will auto-run smoke-suite on post-rollback.

sre-oncall: alert-investigate created: INC-2026-451: embed-synth-5xx-eu1. Capturing traces and tokenizer logs now.

maria: After rollback completes: re-run smoke-suite (canary-small), then run targeted embed-synth extended probes (10m) in eu1 only. Also do a KV warmup pass for session-cache to validate prefix cache hit rate.

jess: noted. I'll pin canary to v2.7.4 until the 18:00 change window and add a short blurb to the release notes: "Canary briefly rolled forward to v2.8.1; observed embed-synth regression in eu1; rolled back to v2.7.4 — investigating."

devin: if post-rollback smoke shows green, we can re-open a staggered rollout with quant toggles off. If failures persist, open a broader hold and notify infra.

deploy-bot: Post-rollback smoke-suite completed: kv-prefill OK, http-heartbeat OK, embed-synth p95=48ms 5xx=0.0% (eu1). Canary status: PASS. Canary pinned to v2.7.4 per jess.

maria: Thanks — tracking this in the release thread and adding the probe snapshots to the postmortem doc. Follow-ups: 1) reproduce locally with quant profile, 2) run extended embed-synth sweep against staging, 3) add a temporary alert rule to flag p95 increases > 100ms within 5m.

jess: I'll update release notes + changelog and ping product for visibility. Leaving thread open for traces/patch notes. :thumbsup:
